item.immersiveaircraft.rotary_cannon.des: Bangalad degdeg ah oo u shaqeysa buundo.
item.immersiveaircraft.bomb_bay.descript: Dhulka TNT, ma burburin karto blocks laakiin dhaawac culus bay u geysaneysaa.
item.immersiveaircraft.telescope.descrip: Nooc ka mid ah muusiga leh.
item.immersiveaircraft.heavy_crossbow.de: Crossbow culus oo leh xoog badan, wuxuu u baahan yahay fallaadho.
item.immersiveaircraft.airship.descripti: Airships may not be the fastest vehicle, but they sure are easy to maneuver.
item.immersiveaircraft.cargo_airship.des: Gaabis ah oo shidaal badan cunaya laakiin qaada kayd buuxa.
item.immersiveaircraft.warship.descripti: Fortress duulaya, gaabis ah balse si xoogan u hubeysan.
item.immersiveaircraft.biplane.descripti: Degdeg ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Hubi in shaygaaga duulimaadku uu ku filan yahay.
item.immersiveaircraft.gyrodyne.descript: Who needs an engine if one could power the aircraft with pure brawn? Give it a good push and off it flies!
item.immersiveaircraft.quadrocopter.desc: A masterwork of engineering! 4 rotors strapped to some bamboo. Perfect for building, and that's about it.
item.immersiveaircraft.bamboo_hopper.des: Diyaarad weyn oo leh saddex kursi iyo pontoons si ammaan ah loogu dego biyaha.
immersiveaircraft.gyrodyne_target_reache: Xawaaraha rotorka ugu yar la gaadhay, diyaar u ah qaadista!
immersiveaircraft.tried_dismount: Mar kale riix si aad uga booddo!
immersiveaircraft.fuel.low: Waxaad ku dhowdahay inaad ka dhammaatid shidaalka!
immersiveaircraft.fat.out: Waxaad aad u gaajoon tahay inaad duusho!
option.immersiveaircraft.useThirdPersonB: Hadafkoodu waa kamarada qofka saddexaad diyaarada.
option.immersiveaircraft.windThunderWeat: Dabayl dheeraad ah marka thunderka dhaco.
option.immersiveaircraft.useCustomKeybin: Isticmaal keydyo badan, waxay burburiyaan qaar ka mid ah mods.
option.immersiveaircraft.showHotbarEngin: Muuji kabka matooriga ee over hotbar.
option.immersiveaircraft.enableCrashBloc: Fur qarax wax u dhimi kara.
option.immersiveaircraft.crashDamage: Waxyeeleeya ciyaaryahanka markii uu shil galo.
option.immersiveaircraft.preventKillThro: Ma dilayo ciyaaryahanka haddii uu shil galo.
option.immersiveaircraft.damagePerHealth: Qiimayaasha sare waxay ka dhigayaan diyaaraduhu inay noqdaan kuwo adkeysi leh.
option.immersiveaircraft.weaponsAreDestr: Ogolaada qaar ka mid ah hubka inay burburiyaan blocks.

option.immersiveaircraft.regenerateHealt: Si otomaatig ah ayaa caafimaadka dib u soo noqoshada markasta oo tick la siiyo, si u eg dhaqanka vanilla.
option.immersiveaircraft.requireShiftFor: Kaliya dayactir markaad hayso shift, haddii kale kaliya gal gaadiidka.
